reasoning: This is a text-editor formatting icon for a right-to-left bulleted list (dots on the right of the bars). As UI chrome that duplicates the standard left-bulleted list icon and sits inside a to-do list app where everything is already a list, it is indistinct and overly meta as a task icon.
